retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait featuring a coarse halftone dot pattern, overlaid with sharp, geometric red vector lettering and a clean white header bar.
triggerTerms: monochrome studio photography with red accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman with voluminous, textured hair, wearing a reflective metallic jacket. The image is processed with a visible halftone dot screen. A white horizontal bar at the top contains clean sans-serif text, while a large, stylized geometric name in red outlines is superimposed over the subject's hair and face.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic texture of the hair and the sharp geometric lines of the red overlay.
Relationship between the white header bar and the dark, textured background.
Interaction of the red vector lines with the monochrome halftone image depth.
coreInvariants: Coarse halftone dot pattern across the entire photographic subject.
High-contrast black and white tonal range for the portrait.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, framed by dark makeup and voluminous hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the white header text down through the red geometric overlay to the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third is dominated by a white bar and the dark texture of the hair.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red for the geometric graphic overlay.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the portrait; high saturation in the red graphic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Header text: Ultra-thin, high-waisted sans-serif with tight tracking.
Overlay text: Angular, sharp-edged geometric forms constructed from thin red outlines.
Extreme verticality in the 'R' and 'S' characters of the overlay.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the header has a high crossbar.
The overlay letters feature sharp, lightning-bolt-like descenders and ascenders.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Thin, clean sans-serif in the header paired with aggressive, geometric custom outlines for the main title.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s geometric sans-serif aesthetic of the header.
The main overlay requires bespoke geometric construction to match the sharp, lightning-like aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast monochrome studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s hair and a metallic jacket, applying a coarse halftone dot screen effect. Leave a solid white bar at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin, geometric red outline lettering across the center, and clean, thin black sans-serif text within the white top header bar.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern visible and coarse?
Is the red lettering geometric and sharp-edged?
Is the header bar pure white with black text?
Is the portrait high-contrast black and white?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the halftone screen does not obscure facial features.
Ensure the red outlines are perfectly sharp against the textured background.
Verify the white header bar is perfectly horizontal and clean.
Confirm the metallic sheen of the jacket is preserved through the halftone process.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Halftone Portrait + Geometric Red Vector Overlay + White Header Bar = 80s Pop Aesthetic
